ونستعينه،: And we seek aid from Him,
أن: Indeed, if a person were to perform an obligatory act within it, it would be as if he had performed seventy obligatory acts at other times.
رضي: May Allāh be pleased with him/her/them.
وألحد: And he who associates others with God
وفتح: And they are eight verses in the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
تصرفوا: They conducted transactions or dealt with affairs.

أحدثه،: He informed him about it recently,
والضار،: And the one who causes harm,

علقه،: a small quantity of blood or mucus
فكُسيت: Thus, it was covered in dust

ويُخرجهم: And He will bring them out
